hi-lo.howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
HI-LO
Step 1,
Pick Your Hi-Lo Count

Choose Quick Pick or manually select the number of occurrences of High and Low number you think will be drawn. Twenty numbers will be selected from a pool of sixty numbers(1 - 60); low numbers are 1 – 30 and high numbers are 31 – 60.

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the Hi-Lo Count for you, or select your own Hi-Lo Count from the following 13 options:

0-4 Hi - 16-20 Lo
8 Hi - 12 Lo
12 Hi - 8 Lo
5 Hi - 15 Lo
9 Hi - 11 Lo
13 Hi - 7 Lo
6 Hi - 14 Lo
10 Hi - 10 Lo
14 Hi - 6 Lo
7 Hi - 13 Lo
11 Hi - 9 Lo
15 Hi -  5 Lo
16-20 Hi - 0-4 Lo
Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play. You also have the option to add Super Bonus to multiply your prize up to 5X.

Your ticket will print with your Hi-Lo Count on it.

Quick Draw tickets can be purchased at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the Hi-Lo Count on your ticket to the Hi-Lo Count drawn to win.
